Mission Statement
.Service, Communication, Performance.
Delivering dependable transportation solutions is our top priority. Every shipment is handled with precision and care. We ensure efficient transit, reduced handling, and consistent results for our customers.
Strong partnerships are built on clear communication. JTS Express provides a personalized single point of contact. We are supported by experienced teams and integrated technology, so you always have accurate information and responsive support.
Performance reflects our commitment to quality. We continuously measuring and improving our operations. This helps us deliver reliable service, cost-effective solutions, and the flexibility to meet the changing demands of your business.
Service
Delivering dependable transportation solutions with efficiency and care
Communication
Providing clear communication through a dedicated point of contact
Performance
Demonstrating our reliability and commitment through consistent execution
About JTS Express
JTS Express is a privately operated transportation and logistics provider with over 25 years of experience delivering LTL and truckload services. Our operations are designed to provide efficient, direct delivery solutions. This approach reduces handling, improves transit times, and enhances overall freight performance.
Our strategically located facilities and coast-to-coast capabilities support a full range of services. These include transportation, warehousing, and distribution. Through a combination of specialized programs and tailored logistics solutions, we meet the unique needs of the industries we serve.
At JTS Express, we are committed to providing responsive service, operational efficiency, and long-term value as a trusted logistics partner.
JTS Express delivers dependable LTL and truckload transportation with a personalized approach. We operate privately and provide every customer with a single point of contact. We also offer tailored logistics solutions, including warehousing, distribution, and specialized services that support a wide range of industries.
